items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Numbers like that, I mean, like Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Titles or anything? I know it's hard to remember back that far.

Well, I remember one, let's see, the Wolverine Blues was one, I know. And there was another one they used to call, oh, let's see, what this, what like the Tin Roof Blues, you know. Numbers like that, I mean, like Louis Armstrong.
Oh, yeah, there were a lot of those, so hundreds of those numbers like that, I guess.
